description: Audit an AI application architecture for EU AI Act risk classification, GDPR Chapter V international transfer exposure, and data sovereignty compliance. Checks provider, inference region, zero-retention flags, and use case against statutory Annex III and Art. 50 criteria.

use_case.description: Business use case (e.g. 'customer support chatbot', 'cv screening / hiring', 'code generation', 'credit scoring').

zero_data_retention.description: Whether zero prompt data retention (store: false / opt-out) is verified.

name: audit_local_ai_stack

outputSchema.description: Structured compliance evaluation with AI Act classification, sovereignty score, transfer risk, and actionable remediation.
